directory_policies.notes.10: Published quarterly tuition: USD 4,574 in base tuition and an additional USD 5,034 in nonresident supplemental tuition if applicable, at the 2026-2027 rates.

fact_summary: Standard systemwide graduate tuition is USD 4,574 each regular quarter. A USD 5,034 Nonresident Supplemental Tuition charge applies when required. Campus fees, insurance and future rate changes are outside this minimum tuition computation.
